description: Previous implementation evaluated wind velocity only once at the source cell center at release time and calculated a straight-line displacement for up to 24h, ignoring spatial wind heterogeneity and 6-hourly temporal shifts.
implementation_details: Implemented numerical trajectory integration (h=1.0h) through evolving spatial and temporal ERA5 wind fields in Corrected50kmTransportAdapter with sub-hourly stepping.
validation_status: PASSED (Check 1 analytical, Check 2 directional, Check 3 convergence)

description: RegularGridInterpolator was configured with fill_value=None, permitting silent linear extrapolation for 9 border cells and trajectories advecting beyond the ERA5 bounding box [6.0, 35.0]N x [68.0, 97.0]E.
implementation_details: Identified exactly 9 unsupported border cells (5 Ladakh/Kashmir, 4 Arunachal Pradesh; 0 monitored stations). Prohibited extrapolation; strictly flagged as UNSUPPORTED_MET_COVERAGE.

description: All non-terrestrial land destinations (internal marine waters, coastal bays, external boundary exits, and unsupported met points) were conflated under a single generic OUTSIDE_DOMAIN string.
implementation_details: Disaggregated destination states into 4 explicit, scientifically interpretable classes: (1) IND_50KM_rXXX_cYYY (Valid Land), (2) INTERNAL_UNMODELED_WATER, (3) DOMAIN_EXIT_EXTERNAL, (4) UNSUPPORTED_MET_COVERAGE.

description: The output column modeled_influence_ugm3 risked misinterpretation as actual destination ambient air pollution or predicted destination AQI.
implementation_details: Renamed to source_weighted_transport_influence_index with explicit metadata declaring it a source-tracer attribution metric in ug/m3-equivalent units. Flagged is_ambient_aqi_prediction = False.

description: Phase 19 stored monthly, annual, and 6-year pooled matrices where individual synoptic dates were aggregated away, making it impossible to answer a specific-date user query directly from aggregated files.
implementation_details: Authored DateSpecificTransportEngine to execute on-demand dynamic trajectory advection across the 4 actual daily synoptic releases (00, 06, 12, 18 UTC) in < 2 seconds per query.
